title: Truth Social: war, loyalty and commerce
scope: A selected statement archive for the Theology Wiki, not a complete corpus or a ranking of political actors.
selection_basis: The user requested material about war and loyalty for the existing contemporary Revelation interpretation. Threats, conditional demands, qualifications, peace announcements and later revisions are retained as related records.

authorial_direction.author: Micah Blumberg
authorial_direction.description: The user associates these subjects with the existing First Beast and Antichrist interpretation. No event-specific author annotation is invented here.

editorial_rule: Separate exact short quotations, summaries, contextual reporting and open research questions. Accusations are attributed to the speaker. A post does not independently establish an offense, policy implementation, military outcome or prophetic identity.
date_convention: Chronology displays Eastern calendar dates. Exact timestamps are limited to the precision of the consulted witness. Collection dates and post dates are not interchangeable.
preservation: Excerpts are not complete-post backups unless marked complete short text. Hashes identify this excerpt text only. No deleted-post determination, original screenshot, full-platform capture or exhaustive search is claimed.

passage_topics.question: How are authority, allegiance and refusal related?
What is the relationship between threatened force and the loss or restoration of peace?
What happens to access to necessities?
How do rulers, statements and acts of conflict become connected?
How does conflict affect interconnected commercial systems?

posts.title: Response to opposition
posts.time_note: Eastern time shown by the individual archive.
posts.excerpt: IF YOU GO AFTER ME, I’M COMING AFTER YOU!
posts.summary: Trump posted a conditional warning in the first person.
posts.context: Prosecutors cited the message in a protective-order request; his campaign said it concerned political opponents and special-interest groups, not the case. The target is disputed, not silently resolved here.
posts.research_question: Who is addressed, what response is proposed, and does a later action identify the target?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Milley and a reference to capital punishment
posts.time_note: The date is reported; an exact platform time was not recovered.
posts.excerpt: in times gone by, the punishment would have been DEATH!
posts.summary: Trump accused Milley of misconduct over contacts with a Chinese military counterpart and referred to historical capital punishment.
posts.context: Milley rejected the treason allegation. The entry records an accusation and reported response, not a criminal finding; full original-post recovery is still needed.
posts.research_question: How is disagreement over military communication described as disloyalty, and what institutional response actually follows?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Haley donor exclusion
posts.time_note: The date is reported; an exact platform time was not recovered.
posts.excerpt: will be permanently barred from the MAGA camp.
posts.summary: Trump said future Haley donors would be excluded from his movement.
posts.context: The original platform URL and timestamp remain unverified. Political association is not the same category as government benefit or retail-purchase eligibility.
posts.research_question: What affiliation is made conditional, how would exclusion be implemented, and does subsequent practice match the announcement?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Hostage demand and conditional threat
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: not a single Hamas member will be safe if you don't do as I say.
posts.summary: The post demands the return of hostages and bodies and threatens Hamas members if the demand is not met.
posts.context: The surrounding message also addresses Gaza residents holding hostages. Preserve that condition rather than recasting this excerpt as an identical threat to every resident.
posts.research_question: What compliance is demanded, who is threatened, and how is the conditional language later reflected in action?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Threat and temporary restraint
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: We are not going to take him out (kill!), at least not for now.
posts.summary: Trump said Iran's supreme leader could be targeted but that the United States would not kill him at that point.
posts.context: The restraint clause belongs to the post. It is not confirmation that an assassination was ordered or carried out.
posts.research_question: How does a threat combined with temporary restraint define conditions for the next decision?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Surrender demand
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: UNCONDITIONAL SURRENDER!
posts.summary: The account posted a two-word demand shortly after its message about Iran's supreme leader.
posts.context: The adjacent post supplies context; the two records belong to the same episode rather than independent evidence of two completed outcomes.
posts.research_question: What terms are subsequently attached to surrender, negotiation or relief?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Strike announcement and appeal for peace
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: NOW IS THE TIME FOR PEACE!
posts.summary: Trump announced strikes on three Iranian nuclear sites and ended with an appeal for peace.
posts.context: This is a record of the announcement; its claims about damage, military success and future peace need separate evidence.
posts.research_question: How do a military announcement and a peace appeal relate to the next documented agreement or escalation?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Oil-price warning
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: EVERYONE, KEEP OIL PRICES DOWN. I’M WATCHING!
posts.summary: The post calls for lower oil prices and frames increases as helping an enemy.
posts.context: It states a demand rather than documenting a price-control rule or a measured effect.
posts.research_question: What actions, rather than statements alone, affect supply, pricing or permission to trade?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Phased ceasefire announcement
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: Complete and Total CEASEFIRE
posts.summary: Trump announced a staged Iran-Israel ceasefire and anticipated an end to the conflict.
posts.context: Keep an announced agreement distinct from verified implementation and duration. This companion does not label the announcement deceptive based solely on later hostilities.
posts.research_question: Which obligations were announced, when did they take effect, and which subsequent observations show compliance or renewed fighting?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Call to arrest and try lawmakers
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: Each one of these traitors to our Country should be ARRESTED AND PUT ON TRIAL.
posts.summary: Trump called for lawmakers to be arrested and tried after their video on military orders.
posts.context: Reuters describes the video as urging refusal of illegal orders. The accusation in the post is not an adjudication of sedition.
posts.research_question: What distinction is made between obedience to a person, the command structure and legal obligations?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Capital-punishment language
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: SEDITIOUS BEHAVIOR, punishable by DEATH!
posts.summary: A later post in the same episode referred to capital punishment.
posts.context: The White House subsequently said Trump did not want to execute members of Congress while criticizing the lawmakers' message. Retain both the original wording and the attributed clarification.
posts.research_question: What enforcement was advocated, what clarification followed, and was any legal action independently documented?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Surrender, leadership and promised rebuilding
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: There will be no deal with Iran except UNCONDITIONAL SURRENDER!
posts.summary: The post makes a deal conditional on surrender and describes rebuilding after the selection of acceptable leadership.
posts.context: The claimed future arrangement is a proposal in the post, not proof that leadership selection or reconstruction occurred.
posts.research_question: Who defines acceptability, what aid is promised, and which conditions appear in any actual agreement?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Infrastructure threat over the strait
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: Open the Fuckin' Strait, you crazy bastards, or you'll be living in Hell - JUST WATCH!
posts.summary: Trump threatened Iranian power plants and bridges if the strait was not opened.
posts.context: The post combines a threatened infrastructure attack with a specific shipping demand. It does not itself establish which facilities were subsequently struck.
posts.research_question: Which essential-service dependencies would an announced target affect, and what later operational evidence exists?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Warning concerning a civilization
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: A whole civilization will die tonight, never to be brought back again.
posts.summary: Trump warned of destruction that night, said he did not want that outcome, and raised the possibility of an alternative.
posts.context: The source does not explicitly identify a nuclear weapon. A rhetorical warning, its qualification and an observed military event must remain separate.
posts.research_question: What deadline and alternatives were stated, and what occurred by the announced deadline?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Shipping reimbursement announcement
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: will be reimbursed, at the rate of 20% on all cargo shipped
posts.summary: Trump proposed a cargo-based reimbursement charge while describing US protection of Hormuz shipping and restrictions on Iran.
posts.context: This is an announcement, not an audited collection record. A replacement announcement followed the next day.
posts.research_question: What instrument would establish the charge, who would owe it, and was it actually collected?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Clemency and expected political support
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: despite doing him by far the greatest favor of his life
posts.summary: Trump described clemency for Henry and Imelda Cuellar and objected to Henry continuing to run as a Democrat.
posts.context: The post presents the action as a personal favor. Its account of clemency and political expectations should be compared with the actual proclamation and later statements.
posts.research_question: Does the language of personal gratitude become an expectation of political allegiance, and what concrete condition or action follows?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Replacement of the proposed shipping charge
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: I have decided to replace the 20% United States Reimbursement Fee
posts.summary: Trump said Gulf trade and investment arrangements would replace the proposed shipping reimbursement fee.
posts.context: Preserving this revision prevents the previous day's announcement from being treated as an unchanged rule. Promised investments still require implementation evidence.
posts.research_question: What changed between announcement and replacement, and what obligations remained?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Bridge or power-plant retaliation
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: the United States will bomb and destroy ONE BRIDGE OR POWER PLANT
posts.summary: The post threatens one bridge or power plant, including in or near Tehran, for each Iranian attack on a ship in Hormuz.
posts.context: It records a conditional targeting statement, not a verified inventory of completed strikes or their humanitarian effects.
posts.research_question: Can each threatened or completed target be connected to documented electricity, fuel, food or transport consequences?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Munitions reporting and threatened imprisonment
posts.time_note: Archive Pacific time converted to Eastern and UTC.
posts.excerpt: The “leakers” of these treasonous statements are being hunted down. Long term jail sentences will be sought!
posts.summary: Trump asserted ample munitions supplies and threatened investigation and imprisonment of people behind contrary disclosures.
posts.context: The collection is dated August 5 in Pacific time; the post is August 6 in Eastern time. Assertions about stocks and alleged wrongdoing are not independently established by the post.
posts.research_question: Who is described as disloyal, what disclosure is at issue, and do records show an actual investigation or prosecution?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Discretion over negotiations
posts.time_note: The date is reported; an exact platform time was not recovered.
posts.excerpt: I will determine whether or not the U.S.A. will choose to engage
posts.summary: Trump said he would decide whether to engage in negotiations and claimed that Iran wanted an agreement.
posts.context: This records his account of Iranian intentions, not independent confirmation of Iran's position. The report supplies a date but no verified platform time.
posts.research_question: Which negotiating conditions actually change, and how are both sides' positions documented?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Renewed reimbursement demand
posts.time_note: The date is reported; an exact platform time was not recovered.
posts.excerpt: should, and will, reimburse the United States of America
posts.summary: Trump said other countries should reimburse the United States after the conflict and claimed oil was flowing through Hormuz.
posts.context: A reimbursement demand is not a collected fee; the shipping claim needs traffic evidence. Link the earlier proposal and replacement rather than presenting them as one continuous policy.
posts.research_question: What payment mechanism, counterpart agreement or actual transfer follows the statement?
posts.observed_consequence: Not assessed in this statement archive.

posts.title: Oil-price forecast after the conflict
posts.time_note: The date is reported; an exact platform time was not recovered.
posts.excerpt: Oil will drop like a rock
posts.summary: Trump predicted that oil prices would fall sharply after the Iran conflict ended and said the end was near.
posts.context: The forecast provides no numerical target or fixed deadline. A future review must preserve those missing specifications rather than invent them retrospectively.
posts.research_question: Which price series and conflict endpoint would be used to assess the claim, and were those definitions fixed before the review?
